units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 79:3">Targ. Ps. LXXIX, 3</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>קְבִיר</he>; f. <cite ref="S02080"><he>קְבִירָא</he></cite> &c.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 33:21">Targ. O. Deut. XXXIII, 21</cite> (Y. <he>קָבוּר</he>, Hebr. form).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 1:17">Targ. Ruth I, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 27:15">Targ. Job XXVII, 15</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:16">Snh. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>לא בעינא דלִיקְבְּרוּהָ וכ׳</he> I do not want them to bury this man (I want not to be buried when I am dead).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 46b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>מדקַבְרֵיה וכ׳</he> because the Lord buried Moses.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38a:9">Ab. Zar. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>וק׳ ביה ישראל וכ׳</he> after an Israelite had hidden a pumpkin in it (the oven).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13">Gen. R. s. 13</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:7:2">Koh. R. to I, 7</cite> <he>דמרבי וקָבֵר</he> which grows and floods, v. <cite ref="S00099"><he>קַבְרִיאֵל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 33:4">Targ. Num. XXXIII, 4</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 8:2">Targ. Jer. VIII, 2</cite>; a. fr.—Snh. l. c. <he>מדאִיקְּבוּר צדיקי</he> since righteous men are buried (it would seem that burial is not for the sake of purging the dead from sin). Ib. <he>הנך נמי לִיקַּבְּרוּ וכ׳</he> they (the other members of the house of Jeroboam) ought also to have been buried for the sake of atonement. Ib. 104ᵃ <he>קברה ולא אִיקְבְּרָא וכ׳</he> he buried it (Joiakim’s skull), and it would not remain under ground, buried it again &c.; a. e.
